response.sql:
WITH spatial_projects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sp.arcref, p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial sp
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
funding_counts AS (
  SELECT fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as cnt
  FROM spatial_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(cnt) as total_count,
    AVG(cnt) as avg_count
  FROM funding_counts
)
SELECT 
  fc.fundflux,
  fc.cnt as count,
  fc.cnt::numeric / t.total_count::numeric as share,
  fc.cnt - t.avg_count as excess
FROM funding_counts fc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE fc.cnt > t.avg_count
ORDER BY fc.cnt DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct arcref value in scanspatial represents one project. Counting 'distinct projects' means counting distinct arcref values per funding source, not counting spatial records.
The foreign key relationship between scanspatial.arcref and projects.arcregistry is maintained; unpaired spatial records are dropped via INNER JOIN.
